input: Find bootstrapped European vertical SaaS companies for logistics or freight with 50-200 employees

companies.name: Riege Software
companies.traction: More than 900 companies in 60 countries, as of 2026-07-29. source_url: https://www.riege.com/company/press/press-releases/riege-software-names-christian-riege-as-new-ceo
companies.employees: 101 estimated; undated current workforce snapshot retrieved 2026-11-09. source_url: https://linkedin.com/company/riege. Separately dated estimate: 86 as of September 2025. source_url: https://getlatka.com/companies/riege.com
companies.last_round: No funding rounds reported in the profile reviewed 2026-11-09; no round date or amount. source_url: https://tracxn.com/d/companies/riege/__NIaoVEJiYVqV7ZAxK0T5kPX5kl3ZE7oqkDH_-DFfkwI
companies.rank_reason: Strongest ownership evidence: current company announcement explicitly confirms continuing family control; Scope is explicitly SaaS and workforce estimates are comfortably within range. Bootstrapping remains inferred from family ownership plus an unfunded profile.
companies.headcount_growth: 86 as of September 2025; 101 in an undated snapshot retrieved 2026-11-09. These are two dated observations, not a like-for-like company-reported growth series. source_url: https://getlatka.com/companies/riege.com ; https://linkedin.com/company/riege

criteria_evidence.evidence: Scope is explicitly described as Software as a Service for freight forwarding and integrated supply-chain management.
101 in the current workforce snapshot; 86 as of September 2025 in the separately dated profile.
July 29, 2026 announcement says the company stays in family hands, with five second-generation siblings jointly running it.
criteria_evidence.criterion: Private family ownership; no PE owner

criteria_evidence.evidence: Funding profile states unfunded and no funding rounds. Together with continuing family ownership, this supports the bootstrapped classification; not an explicit company bootstrap claim.

companies.name: Boltrics
companies.traction: 300+ implementations and 20 dealers globally on the company approach page; page undated, reviewed 2026-11-09. source_url: https://www.boltrics.com/en/our-approach/
companies.employees: 68 as of 2026-09-30, third-party estimate. source_url: https://tracxn.com/d/companies/boltrics/__1kwny02Bou0c1QVFYdu2aFJ-_ORarK62yg8xC1hvKww. Company approach page separately states 50 people in Ede, but is undated. source_url: https://www.boltrics.com/en/our-approach/
companies.last_round: No funding rounds reported as of review on 2026-11-09. No round date or amount. source_url: https://tracxn.com/d/companies/boltrics/__1kwny02Bou0c1QVFYdu2aFJ-_ORarK62yg8xC1hvKww
companies.rank_reason: Explicit logistics SaaS and a September 2026 headcount within range. Founder/director and management co-owner evidence plus an unfunded profile support founder/management ownership, but exact cap table and two independently dated headcounts were not disclosed.

criteria_evidence.evidence: Company headquarters announcement identifies Ede, Netherlands.
Microsoft ERP, WMS and TMS for logistics service providers; explicitly offers a SaaS solution with monthly user-capacity adjustments.
Funding profile reports 68 employees as of September 30, 2026; company approach page states 50 people in Ede without a date.

Company identifies Jan Bolks as Founder & Director; Jan-Cornell van Ekris identifies himself as Co-Owner and Managing Director. Founder/management-owned classification; exact shareholding percentages not disclosed.
Profile labels the company unfunded and says it has not raised any funding rounds. No PE investment was identified; bootstrapped is inferred rather than explicitly claimed.

output.search_notes: Screened as of 2026-11-09. Two companies meet the thesis on published evidence of private founder/family ownership and no reported external funding; bootstrapped is an evidence-based classification, not an explicit self-description by either company. No undisclosed financing can be ruled out. Rankings prioritize ownership evidence and logistics-specific SaaS. Coverage is not guaranteed exhaustive. Reviewed company announcements, trade press, exhibitor-related company releases, funding profiles and registry-derived sources. Excluded PE-backed Fargo Systems (August Equity) and Navitrans (Firmament), and companies outside the employee band. Stream Software remains excluded because SaaS delivery and unfunded status were not established, despite family ownership and a company-stated 70-person workforce. Missing fields are listed per company; source dates are distinguished from retrieval dates. No PE owner was identified for the included companies, so no corresponding PE portfolio page could be checked.
